SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
MONDAY - AUGUST 3, 2020 -
03:00 P.M.
TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20 VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID #898 3555 9493
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, the City Council Chamber and City Hall are closed to the public. Consistent with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County Health Officer’s “Safer at Home Order for Control of COVID-19” the City Council will participate in the meeting through teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will be facilitated through the electronic methods as described below.
Agenda Materials:
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us and on Cerritos TV3.
Public Comments:
Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:
Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to city_clerk@cerritos.us by 12:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the meeting date and agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of the City Council. During the meeting your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: You may provide audio public comment by connecting to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone/mobile call (please select only one method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on the agenda. You must be available to provide comment at the time you are called upon to speak. If you are not planning on providing public comment we encourage you to observe the meeting via livestream or on Cerritos TV3 to allow staff to more effectively manage the number of teleconference connections.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89835559493
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 898 3555 9493
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL HELD ON
MONDAY, AUGUST 3, 2020, 3:00 P.M., TELECONFERENCED MEETING AUTHORIZED BY
STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO
COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 898 3555 9493

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 3:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council were in attendance:

  Council Member Bruce Barrows
  Council Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem Chuong Vo
  Mayor Naresh Solanki

  Council Member Grace Hu was noted absent for the record.

4.  New Business

4A.  Review and consideration of a resolution to be submitted to the General Assembly of
  the League of California Cities calling for an amendment of Section 230 of the
  Communications Decency Act of 1996 to require social media companies to remove
  materials which promote criminal activities (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kathy Matsumoto, Assistant City Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to approve the
  recommendation of a proposed resolution for transmittal to the League of California
  Cities for potential consideration by the League’s General Assembly at their 2020
  League of California Cities Annual Business Meeting to be held as part of their 2020
  Annual Conference, October 7 – 9, 2020. The proposed resolution is captioned as
  follows:

  A resolution of the General Assembly of the League of California Cities calling
  for an amendment of Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act of 1996
  to require social media companies to remove materials which promote
  criminal activities

  The motion carried (3 – 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  Hu
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  August 3, 2020

5.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 4:04 p.m.
